text:
lee-partners: Quick sync: partners asking how to reuse the same Terraform modules across AWS/Azure/GCP when packaging marketplace artifacts. Need a short playbook.

anika: Short answer: split infra modules (network, compute, storage) from packaging modules (marketplace manifest + packaging scripts). Keep provider-specific bits behind a cloud/ subfolder.

devin_ops: Practical example: modules/common -> outputs like endpoint_dns; modules/aws/compute -> aws_autoscaling_group; modules/azure/compute -> azurerm_virtual_machine_scale_set. Then a top-level wrapper module per cloud that composes them.

marco_hw: Also call out GPU SKU mappings. Partners deploying on dedicated racks ask which instance types we test. Let's publish a matrix: GPU family, recommended AMI/container image, tested driver versions.

esther_pm: Can we add a short acceptance test that partners run before listing? e.g., smoke deploy script that runs terraform init/plan/apply (with -target limited), then hits /health and runs a small inference request.

ci-bot: CI pipeline note: we have a template for partner repos: .github/workflows/partner-ci.yml — runs terraform fmt, tflint, tfsec, terratest (go), and a packager job that creates cloud-marketplace ZIPs.

lee-partners: Great. Draft playbook outline: 1) repo layout + CODEOWNERS 2) cloud module composition pattern 3) packaging scripts per marketplace 4) GPU SKU compatibility matrix 5) smoke acceptance tests + test data 6) private/on-prem toggle guide 7) SI handoff checklist + contact points.

anika: For packaging scripts, include a small helper: pack.sh that accepts --cloud aws|azure|gcp and outputs a zip with manifest + deploy scripts. Example: ./pack.sh --cloud aws --version 0.1.0 -> marketplace-aws-0.1.0.zip

devin_ops: For private/on-prem we should provide an overlay example using terraform workspaces or a tfvars file: 

```hcl
# examples/private.tfvars
use_private_deploy = true
network_mode = "peering"
allow_external_internet = false
```

marco_hw: I'll prepare the GPU compatibility CSV and a small script to validate nodes have the right drivers. Partners can run it as part of the smoke tests.

esther_pm: Who owns the marketplace manifest templates? I can draft AWS & Azure manifests, but need to check legal/regulatory metadata for EU customers.

lee-partners: Assignments: anika -> repo layout and wrapper examples; devin_ops -> CI + smoke test harness; marco_hw -> GPU SKU matrix and driver check script; esther_pm -> marketplace manifest templates and EU metadata; lee -> partners playbook markdown and publish to partner portal.

anika: Will also stub out a cross-cloud example app that uses feature flags to toggle provider-specific resources. Keeps demos compact.

devin_ops: I'll add a verification step in CI that runs the smoke test in a disposable env using cloud credits. Failing tests will block packaging.

marco_hw: Note for partners doing on-prem: we need a short guide on network bandwidth expectations for model pull and KV caching behaviour. I'll add bullet points.

esther_pm: ETA for first drafts? 3 business days for manifests + playbook skeleton?

lee-partners: Sounds fine. We'll have a partner review next week. I'll create the repo and seed the playbook. Link soon.

anika: Thanks — this should make marketplace onboarding way smoother.

ci-bot: Created branch partners/crosscloud-playbook with initial commit.
